name: Hotel Hassler
positioning: Hassler Roma, an independent hotel perched above the Spanish Steps in central Rome, with individually designed rooms and suites
best_for: Travelers who want to stay right above the Spanish Steps, near Via Condotti and Villa Borghese
Guests looking for a suite with a private terrace and city views

facts.text: The hotel is perched above the Spanish Steps.
The hotel is steps away from Via Condotti.
The hotel is a short walk from Piazza di Spagna and Villa Borghese.
Every room and suite is individually designed.
Salone Eva offers all-day dining and Palm Court offers al fresco dining.
Deluxe Room guests have free access to the Hassler Wellness Club, with a steam bath, sauna and gym.
The hotel has the Amorvero Spa.
The 7th Floor Terrace is a panoramic terrace where guests can have a cocktail while looking over the city.
The concierge service is available around the clock.
The concierge can arrange a private guided tour of the Vatican and St. Peter's Basilica.
The hotel curates a guided tour of the Pantheon.
The Executive Suites look over the gardens of Villa Borghese.

highlights.text: The hotel sits at the top of the Spanish Steps that were featured in the film with Audrey Hepburn and Gregory Peck.
The Hassler Penthouse occupies the hotel's 8th and top floor, with a grand piano and two panoramic terraces.
The Hassler Penthouse comes with private butler service and a complimentary transfer to and from the airport.
The San Pietro Presidential Suite has a private terrace with a view of St. Peter's Basilica.
The Villa Medici Penthouse has a terrace for cocktails or dinner with a view of the city.

considerations.text: The Il Palazzetto rooms are in a historic building alongside the Spanish Steps; their guests can use all the services available to Hassler Roma guests.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the hotel's exclusive positioning.
WhataHotel notes that, as a historic building, some traditional room layouts may feel compact.
